svg.title: Selected work
svg.desc: Confidential client: Foundry Agent Platform. A chat-first enterprise front door with a knowledge library, multi-agent catalog and Entra sign-in, taken from POC to MVP on Azure. Confidential client: Enterprise AI Agent Front Door. Governed AI assistance across the organisation: secure knowledge access, App Service hosting and Entra app-role authorisation. Confidential client: Azure Databricks Platform. Pipelines, Unity Catalog governance, CI/CD, cost optimisation and cluster management for a platform that has to scale and stay reliable. Confidential client: Microsoft Fabric Platform. A medallion lakehouse with CRM integrations, API and XML ingestion, and orchestrated PySpark, Python and SQL pipelines. Confidential client: Rapportappen. An Azure Functions report generator and AI-assisted reporting workflows on Power Platform for annual reports and action plans. Confidential client: Microsoft Fabric Migration. Led the move to Fabric lakehouses: ETL/ELT pipelines, API integrations, semantic models and Power BI reporting. Earlier: drug-shortage prediction (Databricks, Azure OpenAI) · customer segmentation (SAS Viya) · survey & competitor analytics at BI Norwegian Business School
